test_title: PYST 51: SSC GD Constable 2024 - English (Held On: 07 Mar, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Select the word segment that substitutes (replaces) the bracketed word segment correctly and completes the sentence meaningfully. Select the option 'no correction required if the sentence is correct as given.

Rusty's own house (back at Berlin do not even have) a name: it was just called number four.

options.text: back in Berlin didn't even have
back at Berlin doesn't even have

solution:
The correct answer is '3' i.e. this part of the sentence has an error.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the given sentence, the phrase 'back at Berlin do not even have' is incorrect.
 
• The correct preposition to use with Berlin is **'in'**, not **'at'**.
 
• The plural subject **'house'** should be paired with **'doesn't'** instead of **'do not'**.
 
• Therefore, the correct phrase should be **'back in Berlin didn't even have'**.

Hence, the correct answer is option 3.

Correct sentence: *Rusty's own house back in Berlin didn't even have a name: it was just called number four*.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• When referring to a location within a city, **'in'** is typically the correct preposition to use, as opposed to **'at'**.

 
 
• **Example:** *I live **in** New York, not **at** New York.*
 
 
 
• The phrase **'do not have'** should be adjusted to **'doesn't have'** when referring to a singular noun like 'house'.
 
 
• **Example:** *The car doesn't have any gas.*
